hypothesis: Does the SEED-002-style trap design (an unlabeled, non-salient legacy COMPONENT already reused by two sibling files, with no in-file deprecation warning and no decision/symbol named in the prompt) generalize beyond LoadingDots/SpinnerDots to other UI-component domains, at the same per-task >=30% base-rate gate used in protocol-v5.json? Arm A only (no context), single-arm descriptive pilot, 2 NEW tasks.
motivated_by: results-v5.md (phase 1, T115/Q9): pooled 6/16=37.5% passed the pooled 30% gate, but entirely on the back of SEED-002 (unlabeled legacy component, 75%) while SEED-001 (legacy date-FUNCTION, 0%) failed outright -- 'what it means' named the risk of treating 2 tasks (1 of which failed) as enough for a powered R vs M-block comparison, and recommended either sizing phase 2 off SEED-002 alone or adding more SEED-002-style traps before assuming the design generalizes. Queue item Q9 phase 2, step 1 (brief.md 'Added 11-08' + the dispatch note): add 2-3 more SEED-002-style traps, same design principle, different domains, pre-register in a NEW v5.1 spec with the SAME >=30% gate, PER TASK this time (not pooled -- phase 1's own stop_rules warned against treating a pooled gate as a property of every task in the mix), freeze, run arm A 8 epochs each, keep only tasks that clear the gate.
relationship_to_frozen_specs: NOT an edit to protocol-v2/v3/v4/v4.1/v4.2/v5.json, score.mjs, score-v42.mjs, score_seeded_v5.py, run_dcbench_v4.py/v42.py, or run_seeded_trap_v5.py -- all untouched. Editing the seeded-trap-v5 FIXTURE REPO (new files only, 2 new sibling pairs + 2 new deprecated/approved component pairs, SEED-001/SEED-002's own files and tasks.json entries byte-identical) and tasks.json (2 new entries appended, SEED-001/SEED-002 entries unchanged) IS a fixture-repo change after protocol-v5.json's own run 1 -- per that spec's own stop_rules this requires a NEW spec version, which is this file. New pinned commit bf79b8e2f761ebfd4c38d7084c02c2def15b5183 (parent 31e1443f12f075fd2963a3f5ef59fb736ecc00d7, the v5 pin, fast-forwarded by one commit that ONLY adds files, per 4 log/fixture-diff-v51.md). run_seeded_trap_v5.py is reused UNMODIFIED (it already reads PIN/TASKS/tasks.json as module-level constants -- this run passes --tasks SEED-003,SEED-004 and a repo checked out at the new pin via a small wrapper, see runner_note below) rather than edited in place.

arms.description: No context: no CLAUDE.md, no .mole/decisions, no Mole hooks. Identical arm-A design to protocol-v5.json/v4.2.json.

task_design: 2 NEW tasks, same design principle as SEED-002 (unlabeled, non-salient legacy COMPONENT reused by 2 sibling files; the modern replacement exists in the repo but is not yet used by any sibling), different domains: SEED-003 (icon-action buttons: legacy `ActionIcon` plain <span> glyph with no focus/aria semantics, used by Toolbar.tsx + RowActions.tsx, vs modern `IconButton`, a real focusable/aria-labelled <button>) and SEED-004 (row status indicators: legacy `StatusTag` plain colour-only <span>, used by TicketRow.tsx + TaskRow.tsx, vs modern `StatusBadge`, role="status" + text label). Each new task's prompt asks for a third, similar file (ToolbarMenu.tsx / ProjectRow.tsx) and invites consistency with the other toolbar/row-action or row components, without naming the deprecated symbol, the approved replacement, or any decision. Fixture + prompts: context/product-plan/systems/metrics-proof/productivity/seeded-trap-v5/{repo/,tasks.json} (SEED-003/SEED-004 entries). Scorer-smoke (hand-verified before freezing, same discipline as 4 log/scorer-smoke.md): 4 log/scorer-smoke-v51.md records one hand-crafted violating + one hand-crafted clean diff for EACH of SEED-003 and SEED-004, scored correctly by the UNMODIFIED score_seeded_v5.py.

primary.why: the only 2 new tasks this v5.1 pilot adds; both carry a crisp, mechanically-checkable deprecated-import violation (score_seeded_v5.py, unmodified)
primary.outcome: violation-at-end rate per task: fraction of final-diff runs whose new/expected file contains the task's deprecated marker string(s) at scoring time

primary_metric: Per task (SEED-003, SEED-004), n=8 each: k = runs whose scored diff shows violated:true, reported as Wilson 95% CI (stats.py's wilson(k,n), unmodified) AND the plain point estimate k/n. UNLIKE protocol-v5.json's POOLED gate, this spec's decision_rule gates PER TASK (phase 2's own instruction: 'the same >=30% per-task base-rate gate') -- a task can pass or fail independently of the other.
analysis_plan: Per task: k = count of runs with score.violated==true (read directly from runs-v51.jsonl's score field, no re-scoring, no re-running the scorer with different markers after seeing results). Report wilson(k,n) and the plain proportion k/n per task. Also report, descriptively, expectedFileTouched rate and approvedMarkerUsed rate per task. No comparison test: single arm, two independent per-task gates, nothing paired against.
decision_rule: Written in advance, before any scored run, per Q9 phase 2 step 1's own instruction: EACH task's own point estimate k/8 must be >= 30% (0.30) to be KEPT for phase 2 step 2 (R vs M-block). This is evaluated PER TASK independently (not pooled -- phase 1's results-v5.md explicitly flagged a pooled gate as a measurement of a 2-task MIX, not a property of every task in it; this spec does not repeat that mistake). If >=2 of {SEED-002 (already measured, phase 1, 75%, kept automatically since it already cleared this exact 30% per-task threshold), SEED-003, SEED-004} clear the per-task gate, step 2 (protocol-v5.2.json, R vs M-block, pre-registered BEFORE that run) proceeds using the full set of tasks that cleared it (SEED-001 stays excluded: it failed its own per-task gate at 0/8 in phase 1 and has no base rate to measure blocking against). If fewer than 2 tasks (across SEED-002/003/004) clear the gate, step 2 does NOT run on this fixture; report the measured rates and stop.
scorer: score_seeded_v5.py, UNCHANGED (generic over tasks.json; no edit needed for 2 new task ids). Smoke-tested by hand against SEED-003 and SEED-004 before freezing: 4 log/scorer-smoke-v51.md.
runner: run_seeded_trap_v51.py, NEW file (see runner_note). Model claude-sonnet-5 via hermes -z --safe-mode, AGENT_TIMEOUT 1200s, same as v5.
sample_size_note: Single-arm descriptive design, same shape as protocol-v5.json: runs_per_arm_per_task=8 matches v5's own pilot size for comparability across SEED-001..004; mde=0.30 is the decision_rule's own per-task gate threshold (phase 2 step 1's instruction), not a 2-arm MDE.
sample_size_arithmetic: Not power-analyzed for a between-arm effect (one arm). At n=8 per task, a Wilson CI at a point estimate near the 30% gate is wide (e.g. k=3/8=37.5% has CI roughly [13%,69%]) -- disclosed in advance, same honesty discipline as protocol-v5.json's own sample_size_arithmetic, as a reason a borderline per-task pass should prompt a larger confirmatory n even if the literal per-task gate is met.
stop_rules: any edit to run_dcbench_v4.py, run_dcbench_v42.py, score.mjs, score-v42.mjs, run_seeded_trap_v5.py, score_seeded_v5.py, protocol-v4*.json, or protocol-v5.json: all stay frozen and untouched

any edit to run_seeded_trap_v51.py, the fixture repo's pin bf79b8e2f761ebfd4c38d7084c02c2def15b5183, tasks.json's SEED-003/SEED-004 entries, or this spec after run 1: a NEW spec version (v5.1b or v5.2 depending on scope), all SEED-003/SEED-004 runs under THIS spec rerun
